decisions.reason: As a compilation CD close to the firm's established music-label and mail-order knowledge and visible on its own page in 2018 and 2019, it fits capabilities the firm can absorb and improve rather than exit quickly.

Because this illustrated release series builds on the established offer and spans several models, it draws on strong related knowledge and signals a broader commitment that makes continuation more likely.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP sits squarely in the firm's core expertise in curated physical reissues for collectors, so absorptive capacity is high and discontinuation risk is relatively low.

The multi-disc box set is still close to the collector-oriented core business, but its higher capital tie-up and more limited-edition character make withdrawal somewhat more likely than for simpler core-format releases.

Although the compilation CD is close to the existing offer, it showed the weakest market presence from the start by being only mentioned rather than fully presented, so management is more likely to stop it and redeploy resources.
